EnterpriseTrialRequest.title: Enterprise Trial Request & Security SLA Lead
EnterpriseTrialRequest.description: Stores enterprise trial requests, seat counts, compliance specifications, and requested SLA terms for the Q-CRYPT CRM.

enterpriseName.description: Name of the requesting enterprise or organization

contactEmail.description: Primary email address of the enterprise contact/CISO

seats.description: Number of seats requested for the PoC deployment

complianceNeeds.description: Selected compliance frameworks (e.g. NIST-FIPS-203, HIPAA, FedRAMP, SOC2-TYPE-II)

requestedSla.description: Level of requested Security SLA (e.g., Enterprise 24/7 Priority SLA)

status.description: Current status in the enterprise CRM workflow

licenseId.description: Generated unique PoC license key ID

ApkDownloadRequest.title: APK Download Access Request
ApkDownloadRequest.description: Stores user registration and CRM requests for APK download link dispatch by Admin.

email.description: Email address for receiving APK download link

osPlatform.description: Target mobile operating system (e.g., GrapheneOS, CalyxOS, Stock Android, Enterprise MDM)

edition.description: Requested binary edition (e.g. Free / Community Edition (P2P Mesh) or Enterprise Edition)

useCase.description: Intended deployment or security research use case

status.description: Status of APK dispatch by Admin

NewsletterSubscription.title: Post-Quantum Security Newsletter Subscription
NewsletterSubscription.description: Stores user email subscriptions for Post-Quantum Security intelligence updates, NIST PQC vulnerability alerts, and release briefs.

topics.description: Selected update topics (e.g., PQC Vulnerability Alerts, NIST FIPS 203 Updates, Mobile Mesh Releases)

enterprise_trial_requests.description: Collection of all enterprise trial and security SLA inquiries for CRM lead tracking

apk_download_requests.description: Collection of APK download CRM registration requests awaiting Admin approval and email dispatch

newsletter_subscriptions.description: Collection storing email subscriptions for Post-Quantum Security updates
